info.name: Twitch Helix Chat API
info.description:
The Twitch Helix API provides programmatic access to Twitch platform features including streams, users, videos, clips, channels, chat, subscriptions, moderation, polls, predictions, and more.

Contact Support:
 Name: Twitch Developer Support
